claim: IAM Identity Center can assign your users access to SAML 2.0 applications (a SAML 2.0 application connects to an organization instance), including AWS services such as Connect Customer and AWS Client VPN, which integrate with IAM Identity Center exclusively using SAML. If an application supports JSON Web Tokens (JWTs), the trusted identity propagation feature lets it request access to data in AWS services on behalf of your users.

values.display: request access to data in AWS services
Connect Customer and AWS Client VPN

evidence.quote: You can also use IAM Identity Center to assign your users access to [SAML 2.0](https://wiki.oasis-open.org/security) applications.
This includes AWS services such as Connect Customer and AWS Client VPN, which integrate with IAM Identity Center exclusively using SAML and are therefore categorized as customer managed applications.
If your application supports **SAML 2.0**, you can connect it to an [organization instance of IAM Identity Center](identity-center-instances.md).

If your application supports **JSON Web Tokens (JWTs)**, you can use the trusted identity propagation feature of IAM Identity Center to enable your application to request access to data in AWS services on behalf of your users.
